subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

She said, “It is too good to be true.”

options.text: She said it were too good to be true.
She said that it was too good to be true.
She is saying that it is too good to be true.
She says that it is too good to be true.

solution:
​The correct answer is** '****She said that it was too good to be true'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given question we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be added and comma and inverted commas will be removed.
 
• 'said' will not change because reporting verb does not have an object.
 
• '**is**' will be changed into '**was**'.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *She said that it was too good to be true.*
